scope: Automation lanes for device parameters, their compilation, persistence and integration with device edits and Undo
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, Qt offscreen platform
verified_behaviors: Engine: a device-gain lane replaces device_gain sample for sample with the level lane; a transpose lane is read at note-on and rounded (11.6 -> 12 turns A4 into A5) with unchanged on/off frames; a note pushed past 127 is silent; identical across block sizes; out-of-range lanes are refused

Content: gain lanes compile to factor lanes scaled by the other gain devices; the automated transpose leaves the static note compile; device-automation-v1 round trips; refusals for an unknown device, a second automated gain, non-integer or out-of-range transpose, out-of-range gain, +25 dB against other gains, a device ID on a level lane, and device lanes without the feature

Desktop: a -60 -> 0 dB lane over bar 1 matches (0.7*factor)*source with the factor linear between 10^-3 and 1; a transpose lane from beat 3 doubles the zero crossings of beats 3-4 only; Save/reopen exports identical audio
Duplicating a track remaps its device lane to the new device ID; removing a device removes its lane; Undo restores it; a second automated transpose is refused
QML: the parameter box lists Gain 1 after Level and Pan, the value box spans -60..12, lane clicks at the top and bottom add +12 and -60 dB, a typed point is added, and Undo removes it
limits: One automated gain and one automated transpose device per track; offscreen platform; no physical audio.
